principles: Hash-check enforces the frozen, independently-authored acceptance script
drivers: Schema agreement with the run driver + analysis

options.name: pure-checks-module-plus-unittest
pros: Reusable; wire into the run driver next
cons: Not yet wired into the live runner (next piece)

options.name: inline-into-run-ablation-now
cons: Needs clean-checkout + baseline-snapshot capture not built yet; couples + harder to unit-test

rationale: A pure checks.mjs + offline unit test gives spec-faithful, fully-verifiable completion scoring now; wiring into the live run driver (clean checkout + baseline snapshot capture) is the next infra piece.

preMortem.trigger: hashing the agent-ws copy instead of the harness-owned frozen script
preMortem.mitigation: hash + run the harness-owned script path, compare to the frozen expected hash; selfcheck asserts a tampered/hash-mismatch script => hashOk false

preMortem.trigger: counting total failures instead of NEW failures vs baseline
preMortem.consequence: a pre-existing failure masks a new regression or vice-versa
preMortem.mitigation: compare post-state failing set MINUS baseline failing set; selfcheck pins a new-failure case => false
use exact section-7 names; selfcheck asserts the keys
